## How I work

::: {.evidence-grid}
::: {.evidence-card}
### Define

I identify the problem, constraints, and success criteria before choosing parts
or writing code.
:::

::: {.evidence-card}
### Test

I compare predictions, simulations, measurements, and program output without
pretending they are identical.
:::

::: {.evidence-card}
### Improve

I document useful mistakes, revisions, limitations, and the next test I would
run.
:::
:::
